meta.note: Gold Brain answer for product / builder / SaaS sites

site_story_summary.audience: Builders and operators who want to ship apps or sites without setup friction
site_story_summary.story: The product promises an end-to-end path: describe what you need, get a working result, iterate in chat, and go live without assembling a stack.
site_story_summary.offer: Build apps, websites, and agents from plain language
gaps: Hero must state the outcome in one line
Features should map to jobs (ship, iterate, grow) not feature dumps

after.executive_summary: Strong product sites win when the first viewport answers: what I get, how fast, and what to click. Recommend a Growth engagement that tightens the outcome headline, groups capabilities into three jobs, and uses one primary CTA — modelled on high-converting builder product pages (outcome first, stack second, proof third).

priority_actions.title: Open with the outcome, not the category label
priority_actions.why: Buyers skim; category nouns (platform, solution) do not convert.
priority_actions.how: Hero = what they can ship + timeframe feeling + one CTA (Start building / Get started).

priority_actions.title: Group features into three buyer jobs
priority_actions.why: Long feature grids blur; job-based sections (Build / Iterate / Grow) scan.
priority_actions.how: Three sections with one sentence each and a supporting proof line.

priority_actions.title: Add social proof next to the CTA
priority_actions.why: Product pages convert when a founder quote or metric sits beside the ask.
priority_actions.how: One metric + one short quote above the fold or under the hero CTA.

quick_wins: Rewrite hero as an outcome sentence
Single primary CTA; demote secondary links
Trim feature list to three job clusters
strategic_improvements: Product narrative: build → iterate in chat → go live
Pricing clarity with a free path and one paid upgrade story
proposal_angles: Growth: homepage conversion rewrite + CTA path + proof band without rebuilding the whole product site.
Essentials: titles, meta, and trust fixes if technical debt blocks credibility.

content_suggestions.suggested: Every builder needs a base — ship apps and sites from your own words.
content_suggestions.why: Outcome-led like strong product homepages; no vague platform language.

content_suggestions.suggested: Describe what you want. Get a working stack — then iterate until it feels right.
content_suggestions.why: Explains the loop buyers actually buy.
Specific action; Learn more is a conversion killer.

content_suggestions.suggested: Apps · Websites · AI agents — each with one outcome sentence
content_suggestions.why: Job clusters beat infinite feature lists.

mockup_prompts: Clean product homepage, outcome hero, Start building CTA, three job cards
Mobile product landing with proof metric under the CTA
agent_next_steps: Design chat: rebuild hero with the suggested CTA
Recommend Growth when conversion path is the main gap
